notes: Actual gfx950 compiler assembly and embedded AMDGPU ELF reviewed. Approval is limited to isolated correctness and correctness-gated timing of these exact executables; GPU correctness and serving suitability remain unvalidated. Original debug compilation produced no disk cache; any no-dispatch preload must match these ELF hashes before execution.

checks.owner_wave: First-lane workitem ID shifted by6 gives the uniform wave index; s_cmp_lg_u32/s_cbranch_scc1 skips only the A-load region for waves1–3. All64 wave0 lanes remain active.
checks.load_coverage: Three16-byte-per-lane LDS-DMA operations at m0=0,1024,2048 cover all3072 A-LDS bytes once; emitted LLVM source-address expressions match native wave0 for all16 rows and three K128 slots.
checks.completion: Owner line94 waits vmcnt(0) before .LBB0_3 reconvergence; no barrier inside owner-only branch. All waves reach line170 barrier before first LDS read at176.
checks.lds_reuse: Last A-LDS read line197 is followed by vmcnt(0) lgkmcnt(0) and barrier199 before any C-slab store. lgkmcnt(0)/barrier234 precedes C-slab reads and atomic stores.
checks.arithmetic: Both arms retain six FP4 scaled MFMA instructions, three A-slot reads, eight BF16 LDS stores and four packed BF16 atomic instructions with token_id<M masking.
checks.scheduling_change: Owner schedules expert-ID load as global_load_dword/readfirstlane instead of baseline scalar s_load_dword, adds the owner wait and changes B-load wait scheduling. Runtime performance cannot be inferred from load-count reduction.
